items.title: Gaming Giant Capcom Confirms Data Breach Exposed Users’ Personal Information
items.summary: Japanese video games giant Capcom confirmed unauthorized access to its online account system

items.title: Widespread Token-Spraying Attacks Target Microsoft 365 Accounts For Email Compromise
items.summary: Security researchers identified attempts to access corporate networks which have been linked to a major Microsoft 365-targeted BEC campaign using phishing, stolen session tokens and social engineering

items.title: Attacks on Tech Firms Behind Most Third-Party Data Breach Victims
items.summary: Kroll found that 69% of data breach victims in the past year were affected by a third-party breach, with attacks on tech companies the most common cause

items.title: EU Regulators to Investigate Booking.com Over Scam Risks
items.summary: The EU Commission will assess whether Booking.com has adequately protected customers from phishing attacks

items.title: Iranian Hacking Group Found Hosting C2 Infrastructure in the US
items.summary: Stealthy malware campaign by ‘Prince of Persia’ threat group targeting organisations worldwide discovered operating on American soil

items.title: PHP2Shell Exploitation Attempt Detected by Amazon Four Days Before Vulnerability Disclosure
items.summary: Threat intelligence analysts now observe large-scale evidence of exploitation of the two critical PHP vulnerabilities

items.title: Cloud Security Maturity Lags Despite Widespread Adoption, SANS Warns

items.title: Children’s Data Stolen After Ransomware Attack Compromises ‘Password1’ Account
items.summary: The ICO has slammed security failings by the Welsh local government data unit and IT service provider following the 2024 incident

items.title: Head of AI Security Roles Surge in Large Organizations
items.summary: A new IANS report has found that despite the growth of the head of AI security role, accountability for AI governance in firms remains unsettled

items.summary: Rapid adoption of agentic AI comes with potential business benefits. But if done incorrectly it also carries risks around AI activity management and security

items.title: OpenCode Breach Could Affect OpenAI, Anthropic and Google

items.title: US Cybersecurity Job Postings Fall 26%, Hitting Four Year Low

items.title: Ransomware Gangs Increasingly Turn to Threats of Physical Violence to Extort Payments

items.title: France: Internet-Exposed Danfoss Controllers Drop 71% After Cyber-Attack

items.title: Microsoft Disrupts Global Yam Store Network Behind One Billion Phishing Messages
items.summary: Microsoft and partners reveal a major Chinese-language phishing network centered around the Yam Store marketplace
